dedupe_keys.name: prague integrated transport pid open data timetables stops and real time vehicle positions

description: Prague Integrated Transport publishes open data for analysts and developers on all public transport lines in Prague and the Central Bohemian region. It includes timetables in GTFS format for all PID lines (metro, trams, trolleybuses, buses, funicular, ferries and trains) for 14 days ahead, generated daily and including guaranteed connections and metro station structure; real-time vehicle positions and delays through GTFS Realtime or the Golemio API; a daily list of all stops, nodes, names, zones and locations in XML and JSON; ticket sales points; and news and disruption feeds. Datasets are also transferred to the Prague open data portal and processed by the Golemio data platform. Coverage is one city region. Data downloaded directly from the site are free under CC BY. Caveats: the data are provided as a preview without warranty and may be moved or changed without warning, and the stop list contains only stops currently in use. The data support public transport network models, delay and disruption analysis, and accessibility studies. They complement the GTFS specification and the Mobility Database catalogued here.
